# PackagingSuppliesByMail

> > Industrial packaging supplies distributor offering bulk quantities of packing tapes, corrugated boxes, labels, and warehouse materials.

PackagingSuppliesByMail (PSBM) specializes in commercial-grade packaging materials sold in case and pallet quantities. The company offers major brands like Central Brand and Shield, with products designed for carton sealing, shipping, and warehouse operations using materials like hot melt adhesive, water-activated kraft tape, and polyethylene films.

## Key Topics

- Packing Tape & Carton Sealing
- Hot Melt Adhesive
- Water-Activated Tape
- Acrylic & Hybrid Adhesives
- Corrugated Boxes & Shipping Boxes
- Bulk Pallet Quantities
- Central Brand Products
- Shield Silver Duct Tape
- Thermal Transfer Labels (Zebra, Sato, Datamax)
- Industrial Tape Solutions
- Polyethylene (PE) Film
- Warehouse Supplies
- Edge Crush Test (ECT) Rated Boxes
- Biohazard Specimen Bags
- Filament & Reinforced Tapes
